title: An algebra of infinite little finitistic dimension
description: OpenAI's counterexample (2026) to the finitistic dimension conjecture: a finite-dimensional complex algebra whose finite-dimensional modules have unbounded finite projective dimensions. A finitely presented group algebra with a selection process of unbounded extinction is realized by a single complex of bimodules over a three-vertex algebra, simulated by an ordinary bimodule, and turned into projective dimension by a trivial extension.

units.title: A selection process with unbounded extinction
A Verdier quotient and an odd double
Clearing denominators in a finite diagram
A bimodule complex that realizes selection
Trivial extensions and unbounded projective dimension

prerequisites: core course Graduate Algebra (Li, Methods of Algebra, Volume 1): semisimple modules (Proposition 6.11.4); finitely generated modules over a principal ideal domain (Theorem 6.7.8, used in an exercise)
